_comment: Copy to tools/site.json and fill in for your rig. Empty string = auto-discover (PATH / standard install dirs) then fail with instructions. Any key can also be overridden per-invocation with QUEST3_<KEY>, e.g. QUEST3_QUEST_IP=192.0.2.10.
_presentmon_comment: Optional PC game-fps capture (see tools/Sample-GameFPS.ps1). Leave presentmon_exe empty to skip it. Not vendored -- download the console-app .exe (e.g. PresentMon-2.5.1-x64.exe) from https://github.com/GameTechDev/PresentMon/releases/latest and point presentmon_exe at it. No install/admin needed.
